quotes.text: A bank transfer is an electronic payment, which enables you to send money directly from your bank account to another bank account.
With WorldRemit you can send money from your bank account to your family or friends’ bank accounts all over the world.
It could be instant or it could take 1 - 2 working days.

quotes.text: Bank transfer delivery timescales vary per country but are usually credited within one working day.
